correctness.rationale: Both independently implemented channels enumerate 256 source words and their sets of seven-bit outputs. The stand-alone proof_checker.cpp checks an explicit pairwise-disjoint fourteen-word witness and a linear span of eight; its graph search exhaustively eliminates every size-15 clique by a proved proper-coloring upper bound and explicit include/exclude partition. Its successful run visited 430977 recursive states. An independently coded string-incidence MILP confirms 14 but is not relied on as the proof. All quantifiers concern exactly one local two-to-one edit on binary length eight.

value.rationale: The (2,1) local deletion/insertion burst is a standard motivated synchronization-error channel; blocklength eight is the first power-of-two blocklength with nontrivial deficit from the constant-ball sphere-packing capacity. The exact size fourteen, explicit nonlinear attaining code, and exact linear cap eight quantify both packing inefficiency and a substantive nonlinear advantage at a natural short-block benchmark. This is not a routine increment or arbitrary normalization: the general published inequality 16 is not tight, and the branch-and-bound certificate establishes the missing sharp boundary.
